record.one_liner: Customer support helpdesk and shared inbox platform with a REST API for conversations, customers, and reports.
record.auth_notes: Mailbox API 2.0 uses OAuth 2 exclusively (no API key/basic auth support). Supports Authorization Code flow (for third-party integrations) and Client Credentials flow (app ID + app secret, token valid 2 days) for single-account use. OAuth apps are created under 'My apps' in a Help Scout user profile; credentials must be tied to an active, invited user.
record.access_notes: API access is listed as a paid-tier feature on the pricing page (Standard: 200 calls/min, Plus: 400 calls/min, Pro: 800 calls/min); the Free plan does not include API access. A 15-day free trial of paid plans exists but the fetched pricing page does not explicitly confirm API access during trial.
record.api_breadth_basis: Mailbox API 2.0 covers many resource families: conversations (threads, attachments, custom fields, tags, snooze), customers (addresses, emails, phones, chat handles, social profiles), inboxes (routing, saved replies), organizations, reports (company, conversations, happiness, productivity, user/team, chat, email, phone), users, teams, system users, tags, ratings, webhooks, and workflows — well over 60 endpoints across categories.
record.blocker_notes: A developer can self-serve create an OAuth app and use Client Credentials flow without approval, but the underlying Help Scout account must be on a paid plan (Standard/Plus/Pro) since API access is excluded from the Free tier.
